LAND TRUST STATUS RENEWED

Austin City Council approved recertifying Guadalupe Neighborhood Development Corporation as a Community Land Trust on November 5.

The action also grants a property-tax exemption on certain properties. It applies to the City portion of property taxes—not every taxing jurisdiction’s bill.

The City describes the exemption as support for developing and preserving long-term affordable housing. It represents revenue the City will forgo, rather than a newly announced cash grant.

For Austin residents, this is one of the quieter tools behind housing affordability: maintaining a specific organization’s land-trust status and supporting eligible properties through the tax system.

The vote does not announce a new application window, establish how many homes are available or promise a tax exemption for other homeowners.

Source: City of Austin, November 5, 2026 Council action notes, Item 19. The Clerk’s notes record approval on consent and remain preliminary until formal minutes are approved.
